faq.q: How much does Beltran Brito charge?
faq.a: Beltran Brito publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Beltran Brito offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Beltran Brito does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Beltran Brito have offices?
faq.a: Beltran Brito publishes one office, in Coral Gables. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Beltran Brito?
faq.a: Beltran Brito names eight attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
